historicalProvenance.scope: Approved modern display macro outline reused after the approved political transition; not an independent survey of every historical border or coast.

currentGeometrySource.scope: Only this selected current geometry version; source dates, identity, names, lifetime, hierarchy and other versions are unchanged.
currentGeometrySource.limitations: Approved composite modern display proxy. Some previously identified Natural Earth-derived edges remain in the broader donor and are being handled separately. This receipt does not claim all edges are LSIB or newly establish historical boundary accuracy.

upstream.role: Recorded upstream prepared display provider, with existing local political exceptions; not an assertion that every coordinate comes from that provider

previousGeometryProvenance.role: Retired geometry attribution/reviews only. Political/date evidence remains preserved; old reviews do not certify the adopted geometry.

master.role: Approved prepared current-display donor master. Original upstream survey/GPKG master is not revalidated by this receipt.

comparison.arcDigestDefinition: sha256(JSON.stringify([type, coordinates])) of this version original geometry, present at rows[entityId,versionId].original.geometry in reference

displayDetailReview.reason: Adopt the exact approved modern display-source geometry in this existing version and preserve its dates, political interpretation and uncertainty. Current-source visual/topology preservation is checked; boundary accuracy at validFrom is not newly asserted.

parameters.upstreamParametersRole: Recorded prepared donor parameters; not a new generalization run

topology.scope: Validity and measured scoped neighbor intersections. Union, gaps, connectivity, holes and islands preserve the exact approved donor. Existing KAZ/KAB legal parent/subunit overlap and documented floating-point residuals are explicit exceptions, not clipped. Dates and all unselected versions are preserved, not historically re-established.
